reproduced.trigger: A real kill near a wall scatters loot into the adjoining wall tile, then the player clicks its name from a distance.
reproduced.before: A flow field to a wall tile has no path. The hero remained stationary outside pickup range.
reproduced.after: When the drop tile is a wall, route to its reachable birth point. The short scatter remains within the existing 200 cm pickup radius. Normal distance, ownership and single-claim checks still apply.
